name: whoami
title: Who am I
description: The account, plan and role this AppForShare token works in.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: Projects (one per app and platform) in the account, newest first, with their ids.

name: list_builds
title: List builds
description: Recent builds with install link, version, size, installs, store readiness status and channels.

platform.description: Only iOS or only Android builds

channel.description: Channel name such as beta or live: builds in that channel, newest put in first

name: latest_build
title: Latest build
description: The newest build matching the filters, with its install link, release notes and store readiness findings.

platform.description: Only iOS or only Android builds

channel.description: Channel name such as beta or live: builds in that channel, newest put in first

name: build_info
title: Build details and store readiness
description: One build: install link, version, installs, release notes and the store readiness check (App Store and Google Play rules) with a fix for each finding. Expo apps also get their Expo facts (SDK, expo-updates runtime version, update channel and URL, development client) and the Expo checks (development build shared with testers, test build on the production channel, runtime version against native changes). Guidance only, not a promise of store approval.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: build_installs
title: Who installed a build
description: Installs of one build, newest first (up to 200): device, OS version, model, country and the tester when known, with totals by device and country. Read only.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: build_install_issues
title: Why a tester cannot install a build
description: Why testers' phones may refuse one build: signing (App Store or unsigned), profile expired or ending soon, no devices in the profile, Developer Mode, enterprise trust, test key, plus the minimum iOS or Android version, and how many devices the profile lists. Use it to answer "my tester cannot install". Pass the tester's UDID to check their device too. Read only.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: export_test_plan
title: Export the test plan for Firebase or Maestro
description: The build's AI test plan as a file other tools run: format "firebase" gives Firebase App Testing agent test cases (YAML for firebase apptesting:execute --test-dir, Android only, preview), "maestro" a Maestro starter flow with a screenshot and an assertWithAI check per task. Needs a plan (test_plan with generate: true). Read only. Pro and Team.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: test_plan
title: Test plan for a build
description: The AI test plan of a build: up to 15 tasks ordered by risk, each with steps and the fact it comes from (a new permission, a minimum OS change, a readiness finding, the release notes), and which tasks the team ticked as done. Pass generate: true to write a new plan when there is none or the build changed; that uses 1 AI action of the account (Developer role). focus narrows it, for example "payments".

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

focus.description: Optional area to focus on, with generate

name: github_build_run
title: GitHub build runs and why one failed
description: iOS and Android builds AppForShare started on the workspace's GitHub Actions. Without run: the recent runs, newest first, with their result. With run (an id from that list): that run, and for a failed one the AI explanation of the likely cause and the fix steps, written from the failed job's log with secrets taken out (shown when AppForShare already made one). Pass explain: true to make one when there is none (1 AI action of the account, Developer role); it never changes code or the repository. Pro and Team.

explain.description: Make the AI explanation of a failed run when there is none (1 AI action)

name: list_feedback
title: Tester feedback
description: Feedback testers sent from install pages and the in-app link, and on Team the TestFlight screenshot and crash feedback read from App Store Connect: bug reports, suggestions and other notes, newest first, with the source (page, app or testflight), the device, OS, build (and the TestFlight build) and how many screenshots or recordings came with it (open them in the dashboard link). Read only.

build.description: Optional build id or install link slug

blockers.description: Only reports marked as release blockers

source.description: Only reports from the install page, the in-app link, or TestFlight (Team)

name: recent_activity
title: Workspace activity
description: What happened in the workspace, newest first: uploads, channel changes, tester feedback, tasks, release checklist ticks, link controls and issues sent to trackers, each with who did it. Optional project id and kind. Read only. Team.

name: task_from_feedback
title: Make a task from tester feedback
description: Add a task to the project's task board from one feedback report, linked to its build. Once per report. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Team, Developer role.

name: send_feedback_to_tracker
title: Send tester feedback to Linear or Jira
description: Create an issue in the workspace's connected Linear or Jira from one feedback report, with its text, device facts and screenshots. A report is sent once; the answer has the issue key and link. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro and Team, Developer role.

name: resolve_feedback
title: Mark tester feedback resolved
description: Mark a feedback report as resolved (for example after the fix is in a new build), or open it again with reopen: true. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Developer role.

name: release_checklist
title: Release checklist of a build
description: The workspace release checklist with what is ticked on this build, its named approvals (who approves each approval step, approved, rejected with a note, or pending), the open release blockers of its project, and whether the gated channel (Live by default) would take it. Read only: approvals are given only by the approver signed in to the dashboard, never by an AI tool. Team.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: release_overview
title: Release page of a version
description: One version of an app in one answer, like the release page: its iOS and Android builds with channels and store readiness, the release checklist and approvals of the newest build per platform, open release blockers from tester feedback, App Store and TestFlight state, Google Play tracks with rollout percentage, Android vitals (crash rate and ANR rate per version code from Google Play, Team, read only and never acted on), and a timeline of who did what. Give the version (like 2.4.0) and the app as its bundle id or package name, or a project id. Without a version it lists the versions. Read only. Team (Pro gets it without the checklist).

version.description: Version as in the build, like 2.4.0. Leave out to list versions.

name: tick_release_step
title: Tick a release checklist step
description: Tick (or untick with done: false) one step of the release checklist on a build, by its key from release_checklist. Only tick what the person says was really done. Approval steps (those with an approver) cannot be ticked or approved here; the approver answers them in the dashboard. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Team, Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: promote_build
title: Put a build into a channel
description: Make a build the newest in a channel (for example beta or live) so the channel link and QR code open it. Using an older build rolls the link back; apps already installed are not changed. On Team the gated channel (Live by default) refuses a build until its release checklist is ticked and no release blocker is open; see release_checklist. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro and Team, Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

channel.description: Channel name, created on first use

name: set_link_controls
title: Pause or limit an install link
description: Change the controls of one build's install link: pause or resume it, set a start time before which it takes no installs (testers see when it opens and can ask for one email then; ISO date time, null opens it now), a stop date after which it takes no installs (ISO date time, null removes it), or an install limit (null removes it). The start must be before the stop date. Leave out what should stay as it is. Builds already installed are not affected. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro and Team, Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

paused.description: true pauses the link, false turns it back on

startAt.description: Opens for installs at this ISO 8601 date time, for example 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z, or null to open now

stopAt.description: ISO 8601 date time, for example 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z, or null for no stop date

maxInstalls.description: Install limit, or null for none

name: retire_build
title: Retire a test build
description: Mark one build as retired ("use a newer build"), for example when it crashes on start: its install link takes no installs, its page sends testers to the newest build of the same app and platform, channels skip it (a channel falls back to the build before), and the update check answers retired: true and minBuild for it. Optional reason (up to 200 characters) is shown to testers. undo: true brings it back. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro and Team, Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

reason.description: Shown to testers, for example Crashes on login, use 2.5 (122)

undo.description: true brings a retired build back

name: list_build_links
title: List extra share links of a build
description: The extra share links of one build: label, URL, install count, whether a password is set, stop date, install cap and state (LIVE, or why it takes no installs), with the plan limit (Pro 3, Team 20 per build). Read only.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: add_build_link
title: Add an extra share link to a build
description: Make another install link for one build, for example one per client, with its own label, optional password (4 to 128 characters), optional start time and stop date (ISO date times, start before stop) and optional install cap. It opens the same install page with its own count; the build's pause, stop date and cap still apply. Returns the new URL. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro (3 per build) and Team (20 per build), Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

label.description: Name for the owner, for example Client A (testers do not see it)

expiresAt.description: Stop date, ISO 8601 date time, for example 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z

startAt.description: Opens for installs at this ISO 8601 date time, for example 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z

name: remove_build_link
title: Remove an extra share link
description: Turn off one extra share link (by its slug from list_build_links). Its page says the link was turned off; the build and its other links keep working. This cannot be undone. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Developer role.

name: list_access_codes
title: List access codes of a build or extra link
description: The per tester access codes of a build's own page (build id or slug) or of one extra link (its slug): label, devices used of the allowed count, state (ACTIVE, USED or REVOKED) and when it was made. The codes themselves are never shown again after they are made. Up to 25 per page. Team. Read only.

target.description: Build id, build slug, or the slug of an extra link

name: create_access_code
title: Create a per tester access code
description: Make a one off access code for a build's own page or for one extra link, with a label (the client or person it is for) and a device count (1 to 50, default 1). A tester types it on the install page instead of the shared password; each install takes one device off the code. Returns the code once: give it to the person, it cannot be shown again. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Team, Owner or Admin role.

target.description: Build id, build slug, or the slug of an extra link

label.description: Who it is for, for example Ana at Client A (testers do not see it)

maxInstalls.description: Devices the code may install on (default 1)

name: revoke_access_code
title: Revoke an access code
description: Turn off one access code (by its id from list_access_codes). It stops opening the page at once; installs already made stay, and the shared password and other codes keep working. This cannot be undone. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Owner or Admin role.

name: set_channel_address
title: Pick a channel address
description: Give a channel its own address, for example /c/acme-beta: 3 to 40 lower case letters, digits and hyphens, unique on AppForShare. The old address keeps redirecting for 30 days and the in-app update check on it keeps working; old addresses are never given to anyone else. Name the app by bundle id (app) or project id. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro and Team, Developer role.

app.description: Bundle id or package name of the app

name: set_testflight_link
title: TestFlight link on a channel
description: Add the TestFlight public link (https://testflight.apple.com/join/...) to a channel such as beta, so iPhone and iPad visitors of the channel link go to TestFlight while Android visitors still get the newest APK, with one link and QR code. Pass url: null to remove it. Name the app by bundle id (app) or project id. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro and Team, Developer role.

channel.description: Channel name such as beta, created on first use

url.description: TestFlight public link, or null to remove it

app.description: Bundle id or package name of the app

name: delete_build
title: Delete a build
description: Delete a build. Its install link stops working at once; it can be restored from the dashboard for 7 days. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: email_build_link
title: Email the install link
description: Email one build's install link to up to 5 addresses (one plain mail each, no tracking; an address that already got this build is skipped). Not for private projects: add testers there. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Developer role. Pro and Team.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: release_status
title: App Store and Google Play release status
description: Release status of the apps shared from connected App Store Connect and Google Play accounts: App Store versions and review state, recent TestFlight builds, Google Play tracks and rollout, plus recent changes. Read only. Pro and Team.

app.description: Optional bundle id, package name or app name to narrow the result

name: list_reviews
title: Store reviews
description: Customer reviews of the shared App Store and Google Play apps from the reviews inbox. Read only: replies are written and posted by a person in the dashboard. Pro and Team.

name: list_testers
title: List testers
description: Testers of the workspace with their projects and groups, optionally only those of one project (id) or one group (name). Read only. Team.

name: list_tester_groups
title: List tester groups
description: Tester groups of the workspace with member counts and the projects each group can install. Read only. Team.

name: add_testers
title: Add testers
description: Add email addresses as testers, optionally to a project (id) and to tester groups (names). New testers get an invite email unless notify is false. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Team, Developer role.

name: remove_testers
title: Remove testers
description: With a project id: take away the access given by hand to that project (access through a group stays). Without: remove the testers from the workspace. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Team, Developer role.

name: share_build_with_testers
title: Share a build with groups and testers
description: Give tester groups (names) and testers (emails) the project of an uploaded build and email them its install link. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Team, Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: release_defaults
title: Saved release defaults of store apps
description: Saved release defaults of the shared App Store and Google Play apps: What's New per language, phased release on or off (App Store), and the Google Play track and rollout percent used when promoting. They only fill in forms; nothing is sent to a store from them. Without app, every shared app. Read only. Pro and Team.

app.description: Bundle id, package name or app id from release_status (optional)

store.description: Only when the same bundle id is on both stores

name: set_release_defaults
title: Save release defaults of a store app
description: Save the release defaults of one shared store app: whatsNew (list of { language, text }, replaces the saved list; App Store up to 4000 characters, Google Play 500), phased (App Store, true or false), playTrack and playPercent (Google Play; percent 100 = everyone, null = draft). Fields left out keep their value; null clears one. Only saved in AppForShare, never sent to a store. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true. Pro and Team, Developer role.

app.description: Bundle id, package name or app id

name: rollout_plan
title: Scheduled Google Play rollout plans
description: Scheduled staged rollout plans of one shared Google Play app: release, steps (percent and hours after the step before), which steps are done, next step time, status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, HALTED by a safeguard, STOPPED, DONE) and why. Plans are set, paused, resumed and stopped by a person in the dashboard or the CLI, never from here. Read only. Team.

app.description: Package name or app id from release_status

name: store_upload_status
title: Store sends of a build (TestFlight, Google Play)
description: Whether a build can be sent to TestFlight (App Store signed .ipa) or a Google Play track (the kept .aab) and why not, the shared store app it would go to, and every send so far with its status (queued, sending, processing at Apple, sent, draft on Play production, failed) and the store answer. Sending is done by an Admin in the dashboard or with the CLI (appforshare store-upload), never from here. Read only. Pro and Team.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link
